detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for AWS API calls using the --endpoint-url flag or SDK equivalents targeting non-production endpoints (e.g., containing 'gamma', 'beta', 'preprod', 'a2z.com', or 'aws.dev'). Network monitoring should alert on outbound connections to non-standard AWS API domains and DNS queries for undocumented AWS endpoints.
